reason: Umbrella for four narrow verification skills that share one class: checking a change against an untouched control, on a copy, with conditions stated. Folds timing-on-a-loaded-host, visual-diff-before-after, sqlite-cleanup-dry-run-on-copy and verify-setup-script-in-throwaway-clone. Their scripts are re-homed under scripts/, their detail under references/. Resolves the /tmp conflict between the visual-diff and sqlite skills.

A schema-version store change ran its upgrade on the live metaform home when a server started from the edited tree, before the dry run on a copy. The skill's copy-first rule did not name process starts as a way to touch the live store.
